careers.title: Respiratory Therapist
careers.routeGuide: UG currently lists a BSc Respiratory Therapy, introduced from 2024 to 2025. Check the current admission page and allied-health registration requirements.
careers.forms13: Strengthen Mathematics, English and laboratory science; practise first aid, ethical service and careful observation through supervised activities.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Integrated Science; Human and Social Biology is useful where accepted.
careers.cape: Biology and Chemistry are the safest science pair for many health routes; add Physics or Mathematics according to the target programme. UG currently lists a BSc Respiratory Therapy, introduced from 2024 to 2025.

careers.title: Rigger / Scaffolder / Industrial Pipefitter
careers.routeGuide: These are separate high-risk construction/industrial occupations. Routes are normally employer or approved-provider training with medical fitness, working-at-height, lifting, signalling, drawing and task-specific safety requirements. General welding or plumbing training is helpful but not a substitute for certified competence.
careers.forms13: Develop numeracy, measurement, drawing, tool safety and supervised practical problem-solving; keep evidence of completed projects.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics and the most relevant Industrial Technology, Technical Drawing, Information Technology, science or available CVQ/SCCP occupational subject.
careers.cape: CAPE is optional for many direct trade routes; relevant engineering, design, technology, business or entrepreneurship subjects can support later progression.

careers.title: Robotics / Automation / Mechatronics Technician
careers.routeGuide: electrical/electronic, mechanical, industrial, instrumentation and computer-science routes can provide the foundation. A single current local programme covering the full mechatronics pathway was not confirmed, so verify the actual modules and equipment exposure.
careers.forms13: Develop numeracy, measurement, tool safety, practical problem-solving and supervised project experience.
careers.firstJobs: instrumentation trainee, automation assistant, industrial-maintenance technician and controls-support trainee.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics and the most relevant technical, CVQ, SCCP, science, drawing, IT or home-economics subjects available at the school.
careers.cape: CAPE is optional for many direct vocational routes; relevant engineering, design, technology, business or entrepreneurship subjects can support progression.

careers.title: Small-Engine / Generator or Marine-Engine Mechanic
careers.routeGuide: Useful subjects are Mathematics, Physics, Mechanical/Electrical Technology and English. BIT and other providers advertise small-engine or motor-repair courses in selected intakes. Marine propulsion and generator work require equipment-specific, fuel, electrical and safety training; verify the current course rather than treating automotive training as equivalent.
careers.forms13: Develop numeracy, measurement, drawing, tool safety and supervised practical problem-solving; keep evidence of completed projects.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics and the most relevant Industrial Technology, Technical Drawing, Information Technology, science or available CVQ/SCCP occupational subject.
careers.cape: CAPE is optional for many direct trade routes; relevant engineering, design, technology, business or entrepreneurship subjects can support later progression.

careers.title: Social Worker
careers.routeGuide: UG's Social Work degree and associate-level routes are relevant to government, hospital, school, community and NGO work. The vacancy controls the exact qualification and experience requirements; social-work roles do not all have the same professional gate.
careers.forms13: Read widely, write evidence-based arguments, debate respectfully and join supervised civic, service or communication activities.
careers.csec: English A, English B, Social Studies, Caribbean History, Geography, Economics and a modern language; Mathematics remains useful.
careers.cape: Law, Communication Studies, Caribbean Studies, History, Sociology, Literatures in English, Economics or a modern language.

careers.title: Software / Web / Mobile Developer
careers.routeGuide: routes include UG Computer Science/IT plus current Certificate in Web Application Development and Diploma in Mobile Application Development programmes.
careers.forms13: build Mathematics, English, typing, logic and simple coding projects.
careers.firstJobs: junior developer, web assistant, software-support trainee and freelance project work. A qualification alone is not a portfolio or job guarantee.
careers.csec: Mathematics and IT/Computer Science are especially useful; maintain a portfolio on a code-hosting or project platform.
careers.cape: Computer Science, Information Technology, Pure or Applied Mathematics, Physics and Digital Media.

careers.title: Solar / Photovoltaic Technician
careers.routeGuide: electrical foundations followed by recognised PV installation and safety training. The TVET Hub currently lists CVQ Level 2 and Level 3 Photovoltaic Installation at New Amsterdam Technical Institute.
careers.forms13: Develop numeracy, measurement, drawing, tool safety and supervised practical problem-solving; keep evidence of completed projects.
careers.firstJobs: PV roof/fitter assistant, solar-installation technician trainee and system-maintenance assistant.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics and the most relevant Industrial Technology, Technical Drawing, Information Technology, science or available CVQ/SCCP occupational subject. Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Technology, Electronics and Technical Drawing.
careers.cape: CAPE is optional for many direct trade routes; relevant engineering, design, technology, business or entrepreneurship subjects can support later progression.
careers.helpful: Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Technology, Electronics and Technical Drawing.

careers.title: Special Education / Early Childhood Teacher
careers.routeGuide: These should be separate pathways, not buried under general teaching. CPCE introduced additional special-education programmes, and UG offers a BEd Special Education. Entry and practicum requirements vary by programme.
careers.forms13: Read, explain ideas, tutor peers and volunteer in supervised youth activities to test interest in teaching and support work.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Information Technology and strong passes in the subjects the student may later teach.
careers.cape: Communication Studies, Caribbean Studies and the academic subjects connected to the intended teaching specialisation. These should be separate pathways, not buried under general teaching.

careers.title: Specialist Doctor
careers.routeGuide: Specialist medicine is no longer merely a study-abroad gap. UG's current offerings include postgraduate training in general surgery, orthopaedics, psychiatry, anaesthesia and intensive care, family medicine, internal medicine, emergency medicine, obstetrics and gynaecology, paediatrics, cardiology, diagnostic radiology, neurosurgery, urology and otolaryngology, among others.
careers.forms13: Strengthen Mathematics, English and laboratory science; practise first aid, ethical service and careful observation through supervised activities.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Integrated Science; Human and Social Biology is useful where accepted.
careers.cape: Biology and Chemistry are the safest science pair for many health routes; add Physics or Mathematics according to the target programme. Specialist medicine is no longer merely a study-abroad gap.

careers.title: Sports Medicine and Rehabilitation
careers.routeGuide: Physiotherapy, medicine, nursing, psychology, nutrition and strength-and-conditioning are professional support routes, not extensions of athletic selection. Regulated health roles require the applicable council registration.
careers.forms13: Develop safely in more than one activity, record verified performance, learn rules and injury prevention, and protect academic options.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Physical Education and Sport, Biology or Human and Social Biology, Information Technology and Principles of Business.
careers.cape: Physical Education and Sport, Biology, Communication Studies, Entrepreneurship or Management of Business.

careers.title: Teacher
careers.routeGuide: CPCE's principal Associate Degree in Education route requires five CSEC subjects including English and Mathematics, with specialisation-specific subjects. CPCE also publishes other teacher-training routes and articulation to UG education degrees. Verify the current programme, bond and placement terms from the intake offer.
careers.forms13: Read, explain ideas, tutor peers and volunteer in supervised youth activities to test interest in teaching and support work.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Information Technology and strong passes in the subjects the student may later teach.
careers.cape: Communication Studies, Caribbean Studies and the academic subjects connected to the intended teaching specialisation.

careers.title: Textile / Art-and-Craft Production Worker
careers.routeGuide: The TVET Hub lists Art and Craft Production in textile/fibre and related practical qualifications. First jobs and self-employment include textile/fibre craft, fabric decoration and product-making. Portfolio, costing and market access matter alongside the certificate.
careers.forms13: Create original work, keep dated drafts, learn consent and copyright, and build a portfolio while maintaining core academics.
careers.csec: English A plus the relevant creative subjects: Visual Arts, Music, Theatre Arts, Information Technology, EDPM and Principles of Business.
careers.cape: Art and Design, Digital Media, Animation and Game Design, Performing Arts, Literatures in English, Communication Studies or Entrepreneurship.

careers.title: Tour Guide / Tourism Officer
careers.routeGuide: Tour guiding is not merely an informal apprenticeship. The Guyana Tourism Authority operates a licensing portal covering Tour Guides, Tour Operators, accommodation and other tourism businesses. Training or a tourism degree may help, but the relevant GTA licensing requirements must be included.
careers.forms13: Create original work, keep dated drafts, learn consent and copyright, and build a portfolio while maintaining core academics.
careers.csec: English A plus the relevant creative subjects: Visual Arts, Music, Theatre Arts, Information Technology, EDPM and Principles of Business.
careers.cape: Art and Design, Digital Media, Animation and Game Design, Performing Arts, Literatures in English, Communication Studies or Entrepreneurship. Tour guiding is not merely an informal apprenticeship.

careers.title: TV / Video-Production Assistant
careers.routeGuide: The TVET Hub currently lists CVQ Level 1 Technical Assistance in TV and Video Production. Helpful subjects include English, IT, Visual Arts, Theatre Arts and Physics. First jobs include camera/production assistant, lighting or audio assistant and editing trainee; see the Creative Industries index for portfolio progression.
careers.forms13: Create original work, keep dated drafts, learn consent and copyright, and build a portfolio while maintaining core academics.
careers.firstJobs: camera/production assistant, lighting or audio assistant and editing trainee; see the Creative Industries index for portfolio progression
careers.csec: English A plus the relevant creative subjects: Visual Arts, Music, Theatre Arts, Information Technology, EDPM and Principles of Business.
careers.cape: Art and Design, Digital Media, Animation and Game Design, Performing Arts, Literatures in English, Communication Studies or Entrepreneurship.

careers.title: Urban Planning, Housing and GIS
careers.routeGuide: No current direct-entry undergraduate “Urban Planning and Management” programme was verified. Current adjacent routes include Geography, GIS and UG's postgraduate Housing and Community Development programme. Urban planning is therefore presented as a developing, postgraduate or multidisciplinary pathway rather than a confirmed stand-alone undergraduate route.
careers.forms13: Build communication, fitness where relevant, civic knowledge, teamwork, service and accurate record-keeping through supervised school or community activities.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Social Studies, Caribbean History, Geography, Information Technology and Physical Education or a modern language where relevant.
careers.cape: Communication Studies, Caribbean Studies, Law, Sociology, History, Geography, Economics, Information Technology or relevant sciences.

careers.title: Veterinarian
careers.routeGuide: No current local veterinary degree was confirmed. Veterinary medicine is currently a regional/international study pathway unless a new Guyanese degree or formal scholarship arrangement is identified. Guyana School of Agriculture certificates and diplomas in animal or livestock production support agricultural work but do not qualify someone as a veterinarian.
careers.forms13: Strengthen Mathematics, English and laboratory science; practise first aid, ethical service and careful observation through supervised activities.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Integrated Science; Human and Social Biology is useful where accepted.
careers.cape: Biology and Chemistry are the safest science pair for many health routes; add Physics or Mathematics according to the target programme. No current local veterinary degree was confirmed.

careers.title: Visual Artist / Photographer / Craft Artist
careers.routeGuide: E.R. Burrowes School of Art and UG Fine Arts are relevant formal routes, but portfolio development, exhibitions, commissions and entrepreneurship are central. Earlier claims that every Burrowes route is free or accepts applicants with no qualification were not verified for the current intake and should not be hard-coded.
careers.forms13: Create original work, keep dated drafts, learn consent and copyright, and build a portfolio while maintaining core academics.
careers.csec: English A plus the relevant creative subjects: Visual Arts, Music, Theatre Arts, Information Technology, EDPM and Principles of Business.
careers.cape: Art and Design, Digital Media, Animation and Game Design, Performing Arts, Literatures in English, Communication Studies or Entrepreneurship. E.R.

careers.title: Welder / Fabricator / Metalworker
careers.routeGuide: CVQ/technical-institute Welding or Metal Work Engineering, BIT and employer apprenticeship.
careers.forms13: Develop numeracy, measurement, drawing, tool safety and supervised practical problem-solving; keep evidence of completed projects.
careers.firstJobs: welding assistant, fabricator, metalworker and structural-welding trainee. Processes, positions, coded tests and inspection requirements must be stored separately.
careers.csec: English A, Mathematics and the most relevant Industrial Technology, Technical Drawing, Information Technology, science or available CVQ/SCCP occupational subject. Mathematics, Technical Drawing, Mechanical/Metalwork Technology, Physics and English.
careers.cape: CAPE is optional for many direct trade routes; relevant engineering, design, technology, business or entrepreneurship subjects can support later progression.
careers.helpful: Mathematics, Technical Drawing, Mechanical/Metalwork Technology, Physics and English.

careers.title: Writer / Editor / Publisher
careers.routeGuide: strong English, literature, history, communication and digital-production skills plus a portfolio. Relevant tertiary study may include Communication Studies, English, History, Journalism, Marketing or another subject area. There is no licence to become a general writer, but copyright, defamation, privacy and publishing agreements matter.
careers.forms13: Create original work, keep dated drafts, learn consent and copyright, and build a portfolio while maintaining core academics.
careers.firstJobs: editorial assistant, communications assistant, copywriter, reporter trainee, proofreader and independent creator.
careers.csec: English A plus the relevant creative subjects: Visual Arts, Music, Theatre Arts, Information Technology, EDPM and Principles of Business.
careers.cape: Art and Design, Digital Media, Animation and Game Design, Performing Arts, Literatures in English, Communication Studies or Entrepreneurship.

science.explore: Build English, Mathematics, laboratory habits, digital literacy, observation and ethical service through safe science, health and first-aid activities.
science.csec: Protect Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics; add Physics or Integrated Science according to the intended programme. Human and Social Biology is useful but is not accepted as a Biology substitute everywhere.
science.cape: Use CAPE sciences for highly competitive degree routes. Ministry of Health training, UG and recognised regional routes have different entry gates and professional-registration requirements.
science.after: Use CAPE sciences for highly competitive degree routes. Ministry of Health training, UG and recognised regional routes have different entry gates and professional-registration requirements.

trade.explore: Learn measurement, tool care, safety and practical problem-solving only through supervised projects.
trade.csec: Keep English and Mathematics; add the most relevant technical subject or CVQ/SCCP area available at the school.
trade.cape: CAPE is optional for many trades. TVET, BIT, CVQ, apprenticeship and employer training can be more direct than a degree; verify competency level and progression.
trade.after: CAPE is optional for many trades. TVET, BIT, CVQ, apprenticeship and employer training can be more direct than a degree; verify competency level and progression.

education.explore: Tutor, communicate, organise and serve in supervised settings; learn safeguarding.
education.csec: Keep English, Mathematics, IT and strong results in the subjects the student may teach or the sciences/social sciences relevant to the helping profession.
education.cape: CPCE is central for teacher preparation; UG and current GOAL programmes may support education, psychology, social work and community pathways. Regulated roles still require recognised training and supervised practice.
education.after: CPCE is central for teacher preparation; UG and current GOAL programmes may support education, psychology, social work and community pathways. Regulated roles still require recognised training and supervised practice.

engineering.explore: Strengthen algebra, measurement, drawing, science, design and safe workshop habits.
engineering.csec: Mathematics and Physics are the safest foundations; add Chemistry, Technical Drawing, IT and Additional Mathematics where available.
engineering.cape: CAPE Mathematics/Physics supports degree entry; technical certificates and associate routes support technician work. Match the qualification to civil, mechanical, electrical, industrial, mining, petroleum, construction or renewable-energy work.
engineering.after: CAPE Mathematics/Physics supports degree entry; technical certificates and associate routes support technician work. Match the qualification to civil, mechanical, electrical, industrial, mining, petroleum, construction or renewable-energy work.

tech.explore: Build small, safe digital projects and practise logic, privacy, troubleshooting and documentation.
tech.csec: Keep English, Mathematics and IT; Physics, EDPM and Additional Mathematics are valuable where offered.
tech.cape: Compare UG computing programmes, current GOAL options, technical/vendor training and portfolio routes. A qualification should be supported by working projects and experience.
tech.after: Compare UG computing programmes, current GOAL options, technical/vendor training and portfolio routes. A qualification should be supported by working projects and experience.

business.explore: Practise budgeting, spreadsheets, communication, teamwork and ethical supervised enterprise.
business.csec: Keep English and Mathematics; add POA, POB, Economics, EDPM, Office Administration and IT where possible.
business.cape: UG SEBI, GOAL's current business catalogue, technical diplomas, apprenticeships and professional qualifications serve different goals. Avoid taking financial risks merely to “prove” entrepreneurship.
business.after: UG SEBI, GOAL's current business catalogue, technical diplomas, apprenticeships and professional qualifications serve different goals. Avoid taking financial risks merely to “prove” entrepreneurship.

public.explore: Build writing, civics, ethics, leadership, research, service and fitness where relevant.
public.csec: English, Mathematics, Social Studies, History, Geography and IT preserve broad options; add sciences for technical public-service roles.
public.cape: Law and professional roles require formal study; government and uniformed jobs use vacancy-specific recruitment. No single CSEC rule covers the entire public service.
public.after: Law and professional roles require formal study; government and uniformed jobs use vacancy-specific recruitment. No single CSEC rule covers the entire public service.

agri.explore: Complete supervised crop, livestock, fisheries or environmental projects and record inputs, results and costs.
agri.csec: Keep English, Mathematics, Agricultural Science and Biology; add Chemistry/Integrated Science, Geography, Food and Nutrition or POB.
agri.cape: GSA, UG, CVQ/TVET and extension/employer routes lead to different skill levels. Treat agriculture as science, technology and business,not only manual work.
agri.after: GSA, UG, CVQ/TVET and extension/employer routes lead to different skill levels. Treat agriculture as science, technology and business,not only manual work.

transport.explore: Strengthen Mathematics, Geography, English, IT, organisation, safety and accurate record-keeping.
transport.csec: Choose Physics/technical subjects for aviation, maritime and vehicle routes; choose business, IT and Geography for logistics and supply chains.
transport.cape: Use UG/GOAL study where a degree fits, or GCAA/MARAD licensing, TVET and employer training where operational competence controls entry.
transport.after: Use UG/GOAL study where a degree fits, or GCAA/MARAD licensing, TVET and employer training where operational competence controls entry.

creative.explore: Produce original work, keep drafts, learn consent/copyright and start a portfolio.
creative.csec: English, Visual Arts, Music, Theatre Arts, IT, EDPM and POB can support different media.
creative.cape: Portfolios, apprenticeships, TVET and enterprise may matter as much as a degree. UG or GOAL study should be chosen for the specific craft, technology or business capability it adds.
creative.after: Portfolios, apprenticeships, TVET and enterprise may matter as much as a degree. UG or GOAL study should be chosen for the specific craft, technology or business capability it adds.

hospitality.explore: Practise communication, customer care, geography, food safety, organisation and supervised events.
hospitality.csec: English, Mathematics, Food and Nutrition, Family and Resource Management, Geography, POB and IT are useful.
hospitality.cape: Carnegie, TVET/CVQ, work attachment and current UG/GOAL-related business or hospitality study provide different routes. Experience and service quality are essential for progression.
hospitality.after: Carnegie, TVET/CVQ, work attachment and current UG/GOAL-related business or hospitality study provide different routes. Experience and service quality are essential for progression.
